data.narrative:
Deepnight is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Lucas Young and Thomas Li that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peer companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—predominantly at Seed and Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression modeling, using total capital raised as a value proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $14M. Peer-Median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in funding stage, technical maturity, and customer traction within the Defense & Security sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $12M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $507M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects uncertainty around Deepnight's relative competitive positioning and revenue trajectory versus established peers. Resolution of this uncertainty will depend on visibility into product differentiation, customer contracts, and near-term funding milestones.
